description: Defines the Polymer behavior 'IronResizableBehavior' for managing resize events among web components.

methods.name: notifyResize
methods.description: Manually notifies the element and its descendants of a resize event.

methods.name: stopResizeNotificationsFor
methods.description: Removes a descendant from resize notifications.

methods.name: resizerShouldNotify
methods.description: Determines if a descendant should be notified of resize events; can be overridden.

methods.name: _onIronRequestResizeNotifications
methods.description: Handles requests from descendants to receive resize notifications.

methods.name: _parentResizableChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the parent resizable.

methods.name: _notifyDescendant
methods.description: Notifies a descendant element of resize.
